name: What types of showers can CG Plumbing Solutions install?

mainEntity.name: What types of showers can CG Plumbing Solutions install?

acceptedAnswer.text: CG Plumbing Solutions installs a variety of shower types, including standard shower stalls, walk-in showers, and custom tile showers. When considering the right option for your home, factors like your bathroom layout, existing plumbing, and aesthetic preferences will influence the best fit. For instance, a custom tile shower offers greater design flexibility but typically requires more extensive labor and materials compared to a pre-fabricated unit.
acceptedAnswer.description: CG Plumbing Solutions installs standard, walk-in, and custom tile showers. Your bathroom layout and existing plumbing are key decision factors.
